rules: Regional layout is deterministic from stable sector/content seed and region id.
Performance quality may alter decorative rendering only, never gameplay island/POI/spawn authority.
All eight island composition slots remain present independent of device class.
Regional POI semantics use existing POI contracts and do not grant rewards by themselves.
